school_identity_decision.verdict: The same title and dated festival edition, plus the official direct director attribution and retained school director list, now provide a strong cross-source identity bridge.
school_identity_decision.safe_public_form: Keep two separately attributed statements: Abhyasa reports The Waterfall among films shown at its November2017 festival; the festival trailer identifies Darai as director.
school_identity_decision.qualification: This is not a direct school-authored title/director pair or independent observation. Retained school body is indexed original text; current live body remains inaccessible.
school_identity_decision.usefulness: A modest example in the existing economics school-audience passage adds a named reported event without repeating synopsis or programme promotion. No new article is needed.
